question: Who is designated as the animal within the Kula tradition?
premises: A being situated in the midst of the yogini group is described.
That being is called an animal.
This designation is stated within the Kula.
inference: In the Kula, one placed among the yogini group is called the animal.
uncertainties: Whether this is literal or symbolic is not fully explicit.
plain_english: In the Kula, he who is situated in the midst of the group of yoginis is called the animal.
